reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) describes precipitate formation in the baseline alloy and notes that a different Hf-containing alloy (W29Ta42Cr5V16Hf8) showed no precipitates at 10 dpa, but it does not provide any data or mechanism for a minor Hf addition to W38Ta36Cr15V11.
